intent: Three style-transfer variations of the current coaching illustration for the homepage

references.role: Coaching content/edit target; rendering and aspect ratio intentionally changed

processing: Original PNGs preserved; WebP copies quality 92, effort 6, no resizing or creative post-processing.
integration_note: The selected lantern-bench image is used by coaching.html for the mobile artwork and social preview. A continuous portrait extension, images/game-world/coaching-lantern-bench-portrait-v1.webp, fills the desktop reading-page sidebar. The homepage now uses images/game-world/coaching-right-overlook-v1.webp with its panel on the left and the shared 100svh minimum. The earlier right-panel, natural-height homepage treatment is superseded. Candidate filenames below record the local generation history; only the selected production assets are published.

variants.name: 01-lantern-bench
variants.title: Lantern bench
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Task: redraw and recompose the coaching illustration in Image 1 into a WIDE LANDSCAPE 2048 × 1024 pixel homepage artwork that belongs unmistakably to the same illustrated game world as Images 2, 3, and 4.
INPUT ROLES: Image 1 is the coaching content reference/edit target only: two comrades, a notebook, a lantern, a peaceful waterside conversation. Its fine, naturalistic rendering and tall composition MUST be changed. Images 2–4 are the authoritative STYLE AND CHARACTER DESIGN references from the same actual website. Match their rendering closely: visible stepped pixel clusters, crisp dark contours, stylized adult adventure-game characters with gently enlarged heads, simple readable hair shapes, sturdy silhouettes, carefully shaded wood/rock/leaf pixel clusters, layered atmospheric cobalt and indigo scenery, restrained dithering, honey-amber local light. Match the dark-haired protagonist's illustrated proportions and drawing style from the Notes/Work references. It should look like another scene by the SAME ARTIST, not a photoreal image with a pixel filter, fine stippled painting, realistic-anatomy concept art, low-poly, vector, or flat icon.
SUBJECT: exactly two adult peers thinking out loud together, seated at the same height, comfortable equal body language. Left person has short dark hair, plain dark navy T-shirt, khaki shorts and gray sneakers, matching the website protagonist. Right person wears a muted dark teal hoodie and holds an open notebook on a knee. Seen from behind or rear three-quarter view with no detailed faces. One small lantern makes an intimate amber pool across both people and the ground. A modest cream canvas tote with a tiny sloth charm sits beside them. No text in the notebook.
HOMEPAGE COMPOSITION: wide scenic environment, not a portrait. Two complete adult characters are readable foreground figures, seated height around 30–35% of image height, grouped mainly in the left-center between x=26% and x=48%, and y=40% to y=88%; keep hands, notebook and lantern close to the pair. Right half continues the landscape with relatively quiet water and distant headlands so a text panel can overlay it. Natural framing foliage or rocks near edges; distinct foreground, middle distance and far horizon. No blank artificial rectangle, no UI drawn into the image. Avoid a huge nearly empty sky or tiny distant figures. Blue and violet twilight atmosphere with a restrained peach-copper horizon band, and one amber lantern pool. Rich readable scene, calm and human.
CONSTRAINTS: no lettering, typography, logos, watermarks, borders, speech bubbles, extra people, teaching pose, computer desk, tent, workshop, stacks of books, ice cream, dominant moon, neon, or giant sloth mascot. The tiny sloth charm is the only mascot object. Keep all depicted objects structurally coherent, limbs natural, and both people complete.
VARIATION 1 — LANTERN BENCH: Preserve the underlying friendly waterside-bench idea from Image 1. A weathered wooden bench sits on a rocky coastal clearing beneath the left edge of a broad tree canopy. The two peers sit side by side, turned slightly toward each other; one makes a small conversational gesture while the other rests an open notebook on a knee. A single lantern sits on the ground just in front of the bench. The tote rests beside the left bench leg. A richly layered blue bay, distant dark islands and soft indigo clouds stretch across the background. Make this the closest sibling to the Notes scene's crafted pixel art, with the protagonist's visual style carried over precisely. No town or city.

selection_reason: The user preferred the peers' visible personal space on the bench, which makes their conversation feel professional and on equal footing.
